headline: NBC News projects Democrats win control of the Senate and House; NBC's Senate tally is 52 Democratic, 41 Republican, 7 uncalled. AP has called Senate races in Minnesota (Democrat Peggy Flanagan) and Alabama (Republican Barry Moore), and governor races in Maine (Democrat Hannah Pingree), Minnesota (Democrat Amy Klobuchar) and Hawaii (Gov. Josh Green); Sen. Susan Collins has conceded in Maine, with no AP call yet.
